info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Deposit Lending By Param1-spec
info.description: This API allows for the modification of term deposit lending parameters, enabling financial institutions to adapt deposit offers based on changing market conditions. Users can update specific attributes associated with term deposits using the provided identifier (param1). It is primarily targeted at banking professionals looking to optimize deposit products and enhance customer offerings. This API serves as a flexible tool for managing and tailoring term deposit lending to meet the needs of clients.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific term deposit identified by the resource ID. You can modify various attributes of the term deposit using this patch request.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update specific fields of an existing term deposit resource identified by RES-100045. Ensure that all required fields are provided in the expected format to successfully apply the changes.
